hypothesis: The reserve-inventory step guards createReservationItems with Modules.LOCKING, which uses the in-memory provider by default. That lock only serializes calls inside one server process. With two servers sharing one database, two carts for the single SOLO unit completed on different servers at the same time can both read reserved_quantity=0 and both reserve 1 unit, producing two live reservations against stock 1 (no_oversell fails, and reserved_matches_reservations may also be affected by a lost update). I expect no_oversell to fail in some runs.
